phones.label: USC Student Health 24/7 (nurse, counselor, confidential advocate)

dps.operates: 24 hours a day, 365 days a year; patrols ~2.5 sq mi around UPC and ~1 sq mi around HSC, including off-campus neighborhoods.

stations.name: UPC station
stations.address: 3667 McClintock Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90089 (Parking Structure A, PSA)

dps.community_service_officers: Patrol USC Housing facilities from 8 PM until dawn (24 h during semester and spring breaks).

campus_access.rule: From 9 PM to 6 AM UPC operates with controlled access: only McCarthy (Figueroa at McCarthy Way) and McClintock (Jefferson at McClintock) gates are open and the campus is closed to unregistered guests. Guests must be pre-registered and show photo ID; event guests bring ID and ticket. During the day campus is open to the public, but officials may ask for USCard/photo ID at any time.
campus_access.guest_registration: DPS After Hours Visitor Registration form (visitor.usc.edu)

night_rides_and_escorts.lyft: Free USC Lyft Shared rides 7 PM-2 AM daily inside the UPC geofence (HSC 5 PM-2 AM Mon-Fri). See transport.json lyft.
night_rides_and_escorts.after_lyft_hours: From 2 AM to 6 AM DPS may be able to provide an escort within the designated boundaries (call (213) 740-6000).
night_rides_and_escorts.blue_light_escort: Blue light phones can be used to request an escort; USC Safety says "an escort will meet you within minutes."
night_rides_and_escorts.livesafe_safewalk: LiveSafe SafeWalk lets friends or family virtually escort you.

security_ambassadors.name: Security Ambassadors ("Yellow Jackets")
security_ambassadors.who: Unarmed security officers from Allied Universal Security, contracted by USC; bright yellow jackets.
security_ambassadors.what: Posted on street corners in neighborhoods around campus, especially near USC-owned housing; eyes and ears of DPS with a direct line to DPS.
security_ambassadors.posts_note: DPS does not publish post locations or shift hours ("routinely evaluates where Yellow Jackets are posted"). The current Trojan Hub posts and "6 PM-3 AM" hours are unverified.

blue_light_phones.where: Around UPC and HSC, in many buildings, and on each level of every parking structure
blue_light_phones.how_it_works: Connects directly to DPS 24-hour communications center and identifies the phone location even if you cannot speak. Use to request help or an escort, report suspicious activity or a crime. Emergencies only.
official_maps: https://maps.usc.edu/?id=1928 (Concept3D category linked from the DPS page)
blue_light_phones.locations_note: Exact coordinates not obtained: the PDF host is not on the allowlist and the OSM Overpass mirror timed out. The map research task may supply them from Concept3D.

trojans_alert.name: TrojansAlert
trojans_alert.what: USC emergency notification system: real-time texts and emails from authorized officials with instructions.
trojans_alert.students: Automatically enrolled; keep contact info current in Experience USC. usc.edu addresses cannot opt out of legally required alerts.
trojans_alert.others: Parents, alumni, community: text "TrojansAlert" to 888777 (Nixle). List resets every Aug 15; re-subscribe yearly.
trojans_alert.related_alerts: Campus safety alerts include TrojansAlerts, Timely Warnings/crime alerts and Community Safety Advisories.

livesafe.name: LiveSafe
livesafe.what: Free USC safety app managed by DPS and USC Emergency Planning.
features: Anonymous messaging (suspicious activity, crimes in progress)
setup: Download "LiveSafe" from the App Store or Google Play

crime_data_for_safety_map.note: The DPS Daily Crime & Fire Log was not collected here. The Trojan Hub safety map uses synthetic incidents and must keep saying so until a real feed is connected.

game_day.clear_bag: Coliseum and Galen Center: one clear plastic/vinyl/PVC bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" or a one-gallon clear storage bag, plus one small clutch; medically necessary items after inspection. (Stated on the USC Commencement clear-bag page as "similar to the one used at USC Athletics events"; the Athletics page itself is not on the allowlist.)
game_day.student_gates_note: Student gate locations, gate-opening times and tailgate zones/times are published by USC Athletics (usctrojans.com), which is not on the allowlist. Current Trojan Hub claims ("student gates open 2 hours before kickoff", "enter from Exposition Park", "tailgates on Exposition Park lawns and McCarthy Quad at 9 AM") are unverified.
